problems_model: The main menu card is clearly readable. The menu also has a second, upside-down card in the background at top right and a wine list card at right, which are not transcribed. The wine pairing lines printed under each course (e.g. 'Palmento Costanzo...') are wine descriptions, not items, and are placed in descriptions only where they fall under a dish. The price line '90 per person / 45 optional wine pairing' is a set-menu price line, recorded as other with price 90 for the course group. Some small text is slightly blurred but legible.
